opinion.label: 意見論述
instructions: You have received a QUESTION from a foreign friend.
Write your answer to the QUESTION in English.
Give TWO reasons to explain your answer.

items.question: Which do you like better, school lunch or a lunch box from home?
Which do you like better, taking pictures or drawing pictures?
Do you like cooking for your family?
Which season is the best for a school trip?
Do you want to have a job that uses English in the future?
Which do you like better, getting up early or staying up late?
Do you like sports day at your school?
Which do you like better, going shopping with your family or with your friends?
What animal would you like to have as a pet?
Which do you like better, traveling by train or traveling by bus?

email.label: Eメール
instructions: You have received an email from a foreign friend.
Write a reply email to your friend.
In your reply, answer your friend's TWO questions (the underlined parts).

items.body:
Hi,

Thank you for your email. I heard that you went to a summer festival with your family last week. I have never been to a Japanese festival. [[What did you eat at the festival?]] And [[how long did you stay there?]]

Your friend,
Emma

Hi,

I heard that you joined the music club at your school. That's great! I play the guitar at home every day. [[What instrument do you play in the club?]] And [[how many days a week do you practice?]]

Your friend,
Lucas

Hi,

Your mother told my mother that you made a cake for her birthday. I like making cakes, too. [[What kind of cake did you make?]] And [[who helped you?]]

Your friend,
Mia

Hi,

I heard that you started reading English books. I think that is a good way to learn English. [[What book are you reading now?]] And [[where do you usually read books?]]

Your friend,
Noah

Hi,

I saw on the news that it snowed a lot in your town last weekend. It never snows in my city, so I want to see snow someday. [[What did you do in the snow?]] And [[how did you go to school that day?]]

Your friend,
Chloe

Hi,

You said in your last email that you want to visit Canada someday. My family and I would be happy to show you around our town. [[When do you want to come?]] And [[what do you want to do here?]]

Your friend,
Ethan
